note: Entity Reference validators has no config UI page and no configure route (configure=null). It adds two opt-in validation constraints (CircularReference, DuplicateReference) to entity_reference fields via per-field third-party settings stored on the FieldConfig: field.field.<entity>.<bundle>.<field> -> third_party_settings.entity_reference_validators.{circular_reference,circular_reference_deep,duplicate_reference}. hook_entity_bundle_field_info_alter() reads those booleans and calls $field->addConstraint('CircularReference', ['deep'=>...]) / addConstraint('DuplicateReference'). The circular checkboxes only show when the field's target entity type equals the host entity type. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real third-party setting on entity_reference fields created on the Article content type (targeting nodes).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I have an entity reference field where a node can reference other nodes, and I want to stop a node from referencing itself. The entity_reference_validators module is enabled. How do I turn that on, and what constraint enforces it?
evals.expected_output: Edit the entity reference field (Manage fields -> the field -> Edit). In the 'Reference validators' fieldset tick 'Prevent circular references'. That stores third_party_settings.entity_reference_validators.circular_reference = true on the FieldConfig, and hook_entity_bundle_field_info_alter() adds the 'CircularReference' constraint. The checkbox only appears when the field's target entity type equals the host entity type.

evals.prompt: Using the entity_reference_validators module, how do I stop a multi-value entity reference field from letting an editor reference the same target entity twice? Name the setting and the constraint.
evals.expected_output: Tick 'Prevent entity from referencing duplicates' on the field's edit form, which sets third_party_settings.entity_reference_validators.duplicate_reference = true; hook_entity_bundle_field_info_alter() then adds the 'DuplicateReference' constraint, which rejects a value list where the same target_id appears more than once.

evals.prompt: The entity_reference_validators module has a 'Recursively check circular references' option. What third-party setting key controls it, what does it change about the circular-reference check, and when is the option available?
evals.expected_output: The key is circular_reference_deep. With deep on, the CircularReference constraint walks the whole reference tree via the same field (catching indirect loops like A->B->A), not just a direct self-reference. It is only usable when 'Prevent circular references' is on, and (like the circular checkbox) only when the field's target entity type equals the host entity type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity reference field configured with entity_reference_validators to prevent circular references. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.

The Article content type on this site has two entity reference fields, field_erv_dup and field_erv_nodup. Exactly one of them uses entity_reference_validators to prevent duplicate references. Inspect the live field configuration and state which field prevents duplicates.
evals.expected_output: field_erv_dup: its FieldConfig has third_party_settings.entity_reference_validators.duplicate_reference = true, whereas field_erv_nodup has no such setting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity reference field field_erv_task that targets nodes. Using the entity_reference_validators module, configure this field so it prevents circular (self) references, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set third_party_settings.entity_reference_validators.circular_reference = true on the field_erv_task FieldConfig (via the field edit form's 'Prevent circular references' checkbox, or $field->setThirdPartySetting('entity_reference_validators','circular_reference',TRUE)->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value entity reference field field_erv_multi. Use the entity_reference_validators module to make this field reject referencing the same entity more than once, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set third_party_settings.entity_reference_validators.duplicate_reference = true on the field_erv_multi FieldConfig (the 'Prevent entity from referencing duplicates' checkbox, or setThirdPartySetting('entity_reference_validators','duplicate_reference',TRUE)->save()).
